Monsters.name: Cursed Prevalian
description: Phases on top of their target, applies a disease and chill
tips: Do not let him leap to the group

Monsters.name: Twisted Prevalian
description: Applies a strong disease if in close range

Monsters.name: Hungry Prevalian
description: Leaps on it's target, applies a bleed and hinders

Monsters.name: Warped Prevalian
description: Warps onto its aggresors if they're atacking in range instead of close combat
Applies a disease which stacks quickly
tips: Don't engage at range, let it get closer or ignore

Monsters.name: Lesser Balron
tips: Do not use an arcane staff on this mob
Swords, Traps, and other melee prefered

Monsters.name: Watchman of the Void
tips: Aggro range is 14-16 tiles, pull close

Monsters.name: Sigil of the Void
description: Places a trap on top of its target that detonates briefly after
Applies stacking grievious wounds and pierce

Bosses.name: High Priestess of the Void
tips: Negate Grievous Wound: Mend Rune, Void Armor, Omni Pots, Refresh, Sapling
Archers should stay at 14 tiles and watch overhead for ability
6-8 second DPS window after ability, then repeat

Monsters.name: Chaotic Mass
description: A volley attack thats single target dps. Retaliates when dpsed from range applying grievious wounds,poison and **

Monsters.name: Chaos Spawn
description: Single target dps that hinders,low CD on its ability paired up with a lonog lasting hinder
Changes agro onto whoever is running

Monsters.name: Chaos Dweller
description: Deflects,its special is similar to soldiers of the void(plus charging its dps

Monsters.name: Spellweaver
description: Phases applying a disease and chill effect
on proc ability on cast similar to Pontifs

Monsters.name: Feaster
description: Aoes all its targets withing LOS when enganged

Monsters.name: Bedlam Gazer
description: retaliates with a special when hit regardless of distance
special hinders and has wide area

Monsters.name: Balron
description: Same as lessers though they apply more % of debuf
deflect more often and have higher stats

Monsters.name: Young Drake
description: A juvenile dragon still learning to hunt.
Dangerous with flame breath and sharp claws.
tips: Avoid standing in front of its mouth
Use lightning-based spells to interrupt breath attacks
Attack from the sides or behind when possible

Monsters.name: Twisted Horror
description: A creature warped by dark magic beyond recognition.
tips: Its movements are chaotic and hard to predict
Pure energy attacks work best against it
Maintain distance and use ranged attacks

Bosses.name: Ancient Dragon
description: A massive dragon of incredible age and power.
One of the most formidable foes in the realm.
tips: This is an endgame boss - prepare thoroughly
Learn its attack patterns before committing
Target the wings to prevent it from flying away

Monsters.name: Shadow Wraith
description: A spirit of pure darkness given form.
Immune to physical damage, requires special weapons.
tips: Regular weapons are useless - use enchanted arms
Holy light will weaken and slow it down
Can only be hurt with blessed or magical weapons

Monsters.name: Abyssal Spawn
description: A creature pulled from the depths of the abyss.
Emanates an aura of pure malevolence.
tips: Its aura causes continuous damage - use wards
Protection spells are essential before engaging
It spawns adds when it takes severe damage

Bosses.name: Abyssal Guardian
description: A powerful entity guarding the deepest dungeons.
The ultimate test of strength and courage.
tips: This is the ultimate challenge - prepare your best gear
Coordinate with your party and use all available resources
